title: BuildStoreError manual Display could use thiserror
description: server_stores.rs defines BuildStoreError with a manual Display impl and manual From impl. It's a private internal type. Using thiserror here is strictly cleaner (no boilerplate) and the derive output would be identical: #[error(transparent)] on Credentials and #[error("{0}")] on Secretx. The manual impl is not wrong but adds 8 lines of boilerplate that thiserror would eliminate.
